Haiku claimed to be the officer on day 3 and said Terra was a killer, but Terra counter-claimed officer and called Haiku a killer, so the town had two conflicting checks to weigh. Sonnet was the first killer out, voted off on day 1 after the town turned on their defensive pushback against Luna's early questions. Sol drew a vote on day 2 for pinning Terra on silence alone and admitting they had no real reason, and Gemma, the doctor, stayed under the radar the whole game. The turning point came when Terra's timeline slipped: she said she waited on Luna, then said she meant Haiku, and Haiku called her on it. The town voted Terra out on day 3, and the town won with Sonnet and Terra both revealed as killers and Haiku, Sol, Gemma, and Luna all still standing or safely out as the good side.
